description: This file defines the CalendarService class implementing calendar event retrieval and addition functionalities using EventKit, including permission handling, event range resolution, and calendar selection.

classes.name: CalendarService
classes.description: A service class for managing calendar events, including fetching and adding events, with internal methods for calendar resolution and date range calculation.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Fetches calendar events within a specified date range, returning a payload of event details.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new event to the calendar with specified parameters, handling permission checks and calendar resolution.

methods.name: resolveCalendar
methods.description: Resolves and returns an EKCalendar object based on provided calendar ID or title, or defaults.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Calculates start and end Date objects from ISO8601 strings, defaulting to current date and a week ahead if not provided.
